description: RANGER-Recovery 3-of-5 under transmission-side degradation applied only after successful bootstrap.
interpretation: Bootstrap runs with healthy UDGM TX/RX. SUCCESS_RATIO_TX is changed only after RANGER_CODED_READY. Recovery smoke modes remain disabled.
primary_question: Does one-hop two-round RANGER-Recovery improve 3-of-5 rekey completion and reconstructed membership under post-bootstrap transmission loss, and at what request/repair cost?
